content.short: Mantle is a modular Ethereum L2 network using Optimistic Rollups and EigenDA for high-performance DeFi.
content.description:
Mantle is a high-performance modular Ethereum Layer 2 network, designed to provide a scalable and cost-effective environment for decentralized applications. By utilizing Optimistic Rollups and being the first to adopt EigenDA for modular data availability, Mantle achieves high throughput and sub-second finality while inheriting the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet. The network is powered by the $MNT token, which facilitates transaction fees, staking, and decentralized governance.

Positioned as a "banking blockchain," Mantle aims to bridge the gap between Traditional Finance (TradFi) and the decentralized economy through institutional-grade infrastructure. The network hosts a vibrant ecosystem of DeFi protocols, including Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSDs) and money markets, fostering deep liquidity and innovation. Through its modular architecture and community-driven development via the Mantle Treasury, the project is building the essential framework for the next generation of global financial services on-chain.
content.meta: Mantle is a modular Ethereum Layer 2 network providing scalable, secure, and low-cost infrastructure for Web3 dApps.
